description: Repair infrastructure launch and exhaust minimum-distortion positional unions
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,085 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 20 prior macro-attempts in this family and 21 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0076, whose 20 nearest positional unions reduced the frontier from 2,105 to 2,085 parameters at 99.04%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0077, an infrastructure error before source archival, training, scoring, or micro-trial recording because sandboxed Git access left an unusable micro directory. This is the permitted repair of the same intended candidate: run with repository-write permission established before the first micro-trial; architecture, candidate ordering, acceptance, and stopping conditions are unchanged. Hypothesis: further parameterization-preserving minimum-difference positional unions can reduce count while preserving qualification. Ordering is ascending absolute difference between current group values, recomputed after every accepted union, and is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because each chosen pair has minimum current distortion. The official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop at the first scored failure, any further reproducible error, or no remaining pair. The 478-trial cap covers all possible unions among 479 current groups. Compute budget: at most 478 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 10 wall-clock hours, with the first stop condition taking precedence.
summary: Evaluated 293 consecutive minimum-difference positional group unions (micro-0001 through micro-0293). The first 292 qualified and were retained, moving the frontier from 2,085 parameters at 99.04% to 1,793 parameters at 99.01%; micro-0293 proposed 1,792 parameters and scored 98.97%, so it was discarded and rolled back. There were 0 errors. Compute used checkpoint migration plus 293 official verifications, no fresh optimization, over 5h29m09s wall clock from automation start to the scored boundary. Stop reason: the first scored failure closed the declared greedy minimum-distortion path before the 478-trial/10-hour cap.
